Click a quantity, press Enter or start typing to open the editor. Adjust by adds or removes stock and Set to enters a count, with a live preview such as 42 → 47. The arrow keys step by 1, or by 10 with Shift. Enter keeps the change in a draft and moves down a row, and Escape cancels. Edited cells get a dot and show their delta, and a save bar collects the batch with one reason, such as Received or Cycle count.
Column names, filters, save bar and empty-state words.

Inventory Table with inline editing for React

Inventory is the stock table for one location. Each row is a variant with its thumbnail, title and SKU. The columns follow Shopify: Unavailable, Committed, Available, On hand and Incoming. On hand is always Available plus Committed plus Unavailable, so editing one of them moves the other by the same amount.

Rows don’t move while focus is in the table or a popover is open, so live updates never pull the row out from under a screen reader or keyboard user. Number rolls and flashes are turned off for reduced motion.
Save to Shopify
Saves the draft.

Saving sends adjustments, not overwrites. Each one carries its delta, the quantity it was based on and the result, so an order placed while you were typing isn’t lost. A row the server rejects stays in the draft with its message, such as “Quantity changed to 40 by another device”, and Reapply sends it again on top of the new quantity.
Selects or clears the row when its checkbox has focus.
Sellable stock. Can be negative when overselling is allowed.

When new items arrive, changed numbers roll digit by digit and flash briefly. Rows don’t re-sort while you’re working in the table. The toolbar has search by title or SKU, Low stock, Out of stock and Incoming filters, sorting by Available, and bulk Set to 0 or Adjust by for selected rows. Loading, an empty location, no results, untracked variants, oversold stock and an all-locations read-only view are covered too, and every row has its adjustment history in a sheet.
